banner.title: The Dragon issue-22 opener part three - the commentary set
banner.provenance: The part-three round of the issue-22 four-round shape - five chains of the Curtiss TD-22 call pinned as the commentary set: the Gygax design-philosophy essay What It Is and Where It Is Going (print 29-30), the Gygax pole arms taxonomy (print 50-54), the Berg rebuttal SPI on AD and D (print 44), the Gosling battle report Stalemate at Kassala (print 45-47) and the Mapping the Dungeons games catalog riding the International DM Search roster (print 18-28). Pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 8 (February 1979) print 18-30 and 44-54 at extract/dragon/022, PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE this issue, the transcript of the Curtiss-provided scan. The interleaved ads ride the standing drop list; the flip to close all three report-022 boxes follows at R949.
